archetypes.name: dyn-ship-rebase
archetypes.rationale: Ship pre-fix rebase routing now depends on sentinel and phase14 flag ordering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the ship pre-fix rebase changes in dispatch_ship.py and the corresponding SKILL.md routing guard. Check that stale phase14 flags, in-progress rebases, conflict metadata, and sentinel writes fail closed without accidentally blocking valid no-checks reship continuations. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
